people.name: Nick Candy
people.title: Chief Executive Officer
people.bio:
Nick Candy is a British luxury real estate developer and co-founder of world-leading interior design and development management firm Candy & Candy (now Candy London). His groundbreaking project – the globally celebrated One Hyde Park – revolutionised the property market worldwide, breaking industry records and setting unparalleled new standards in luxury design and living. 

Nick operates a private family office overseeing a diverse group of companies spanning real estate, design, development, and a portfolio of multi-stage investments in tech, digital media, consumer and sports, biotech, sustainability, and natural resources.

With a long-standing affiliation with the Middle East, Candy is actively engaged in a number of significant real estate and hospitality projects across the region through joint venture partnerships at the highest level.

Recognised as a distinguished figure and innovator within the real estate community, Nick is a regular commentator in the media on industry topics and trends, and his visionary insights have earned him widespread acclaim and recognition.

people.name: Fritz Dickamp
people.title: Managing Director
people.bio:
After graduating from EHL in Switzerland in 2013, Fritz turned his passion for hospitality into an agency, empowering clients across Europe and the Middle East to shine online.
 
Charismatic, entertaining, and insightful, he sparks conversations on the future of hospitality, digital trends, and brand storytelling.
 
He has inspired audiences at ITB Berlin, WTM London, FHS World and as a TEDx speaker, serves as a guest lecturer, and regularly hosts the SMACK Hospitality podcast.

people.name: Larissa Esser
people.title: Senior Advisor
people.bio:
Larissa Esser serves as a Senior Advisor to Colliers' Hospitality Capital Markets teams, bridging global clients with global deals across the EMEA region and worldwide. She possesses more than 17 years of deep expertise in real estate investment banking and hotel brokerage, having worked with globally recognized firms in both Europe and the United States.

Larissa’s core expertise lies at the intersection of hotel operations and real estate finance. Specifically, she specializes in monetizing current hospitality trends, designing optimal capital structures, and maximizing underlying asset values. Driven by the belief that hospitality is fundamental to user-centric spaces, Larissa applies her strategic vision not only to traditional hotels but also to modern living models in the broadest sense.

people.name: Jan Garde
people.title: Founder & Chairman
people.company: THE EMBASSIES OF GOOD LIVING AG
people.bio:
Jan Garde is the Founder and Chairman of THE EMBASSIES OF GOOD LIVING, reimagining how and where we live as life evolves. Part global members club, part serviced living concept, THE EMBASSIES brings together cross-generational tenants in beautifully designed spaces at the heart of the world’s most inspiring cities.

The first location is in Hamburg, with more to follow. Jan divides his time between Cologne, Zurich, and Hamburg, is married with two sons, and spent two decades in brand and experience design before founding THE EMBASSIES.

people.name: Jasper Gilbey
people.title: Head of Housing, Alternatives & Strategic Transactions, Europe

people.name: Guy Ivesha
people.title: Founder
people.bio:
Guy Ivesha is a hospitality entrepreneur, operator and developer with over 25 years of experience across luxury hotels, real estate and brand creation. He is the Founder of Maslow’s, a members’ platform integrating hospitality, wellbeing, design and workspace, and Senior Advisor to Cain International, supporting its global hospitality investment strategy.

Previously, he led acquisitions and development at PPHE Hotel Group and oversaw the Plaza Hotel’s redevelopment, reopening and asset management at El Ad Properties in New York. Guy combines investment expertise with operational experience to create distinctive hospitality concepts, reposition assets and build brands that deliver commercial value and exceptional experiences.

people.name: Eric Jafari
people.title: Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio:
Eric Jafari is the Founder and CEO of AENDRE, a European hospitality investment and development platform creating lifestyle extended-stay and hybrid living brands. Eric was previously Co-Founder and Chief Development Officer at Brookfield-backed Edyn, one of Europe's largest aparthotel groups.

Under Oaktree's stewardship, he and his team repositioned the SACO portfolio, creating and launching the Locke brand before selling the platform to Brookfield in 2018. Under Brookfield's ownership, they scaled the platform fourfold across Europe between 2018 and 2023. Prior to this, Eric was Co-Founder and Managing Director at Union Hanover Securities, overseeing a £400 million development portfolio.

people.name: David Keen
people.title: Founder & CEO
people.bio:
An evangelist for the power of experiential branding, David Keen is a successful entrepreneur and leading strategist for the travel and hospitality industries. Over the last 20 years, David has published and been interviewed in dozens of publications and has been a featured speaker at numerous conferences, tradeshows and professional events.

David was born in London and educated in New York at Cornell University’s School of Hotel Administration. After embarking on his career in London and the United States, David ventured to Asia as a writer and editor, traveling widely in the region.
 
In 1997, David settled in Bangkok, where he founded QUO, a brand strategy and integrated communications agency. Today, QUO’s portfolio spans five continents and includes many of the world’s most venerated hotels and resorts, tourism destinations, United Nations agencies, and international organizations. As CEO, David leads a team of over 90 esteemed professionals from around the globe and continues to grow QUO.

people.name: Barry Landsberg
people.title: Principal
people.bio:
Barry Landsberg brings over 25 years of global experience in the development of luxury and lifestyle branded residences. He advises developers and hospitality brands worldwide, delivering end to end expertise across mixed use, master planned, and standalone residential projects.

Barry built his career with Fairmont Raffles/FRHI/Accor, where he supported a diverse international portfolio, and later as Vice President at Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, leading residential development marketing and sales for both urban and resort projects throughout the Americas. 

As Principal of Landsberg Residential Consulting his work spans the Americas, Caribbean, UK, Turkey, Morocco, Egypt, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Indonesia, Philippines, and China – in partnership with leading luxury brands including Four Seasons, Fairmont, Raffles, Jumeirah, Baccarat, and St. Regis – the firm delivers:

- Senior residential development leadership, strengthening developers’ internal teams and external resources to execute top performing luxury residential projects.
- Accelerated pre development support, providing the structure, insights, and momentum needed to fast track early stage planning for luxury and lifestyle residential initiatives.
- Expert guidance across operator selection, legal agreements, design, and project positioning, ensuring alignment with developer vision and resonance with the target luxury consumer – covering product definition, services, amenities, rental program strategy, operating model, and marketing and sales approach.
-Collaboration with hospitality and consumer brands to conceptualize and build the tools, resources, and operational infrastructure required to launch and sustain a branded residential offering.

people.name: Michael Levie
people.title: Co-Founder
people.bio: Michael Levie; upon graduating from Essec MBA in hospitality management (IMHI Cornell / Essec), worked for various international hotel chains including Sonesta International Hotels Corporation and NH Hoteles all over the world. As Vice-President of Operations, he managed large hotel portfolios. Michael also worked for SynXis, where he started and headed up the European office. Michael Levie is a founding partner of citizenM hotels and was responsible for the hotel side of the company. Currently Michael’s focus is on assisting organizations in the hospitality space, who accelerate and impact transformation.

people.name: Dimitris Manikis
people.title: President EMEA
people.bio:
Dimitris is responsible for the development of Wyndham Hotels & Resorts’ brands in the EMEA region as well as maximising the performance of all new and existing franchise and managed hotels.

Dimitris has a long-standing career in the hospitality industry. Prior to joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts in 2018, he spent over 27 years with RCI, the worldwide leader in vacation exchange.

Dimitris is a Board Member for the World Sustainable Hospitality Association, an Industry Advisory Board member for Hotelschool The Hague and a Member of the HSMAI Europe Board of Directors.

people.name: Annemarie Manning
people.title: Head of Investor Solutions
people.bio:
Annemarie is Head of Investor Solutions at Orange Capital Partners. Prior to joining OCP in 2024, Annemarie was for 8 years the Head of Business Development and Investor Relations at ActivumSG.

Annemarie brings a unique industry perspective, resulting from a dynamic career 
encompassing a variety of sectors and roles. Over 10+ years of experience on the direct and indirect real estate investment side laid down a strong foundation for business development and investor relations. Her career in real estate began in 1998 as an analyst underwriting platform transactions at Security Capital and asset transactions at Doughty Hanson in London. Following this, Annemarie worked for eight years at APG Investments as a senior portfolio manager for private equity real estate and debt, before moving back to London to join Greenhill and subsequently PGIM to gain experience in capital raising.

Annemarie has a master’s degree in economics from the University of Amsterdam and a master’s degree in real estate, project management and housing from the Technical 
University of Delft.

people.name: Lauren Okada Young
people.title: Managing Director, Head of European Housing & Hospitality
people.bio:
Lauren Okada Young is a Managing Director in Brookfield’s Real Estate Group. In this role, she focuses on investments and portfolio management in the hospitality and housing sectors across Europe. Brookfield's portfolio companies in Europe include Center Parcs UK & Ireland, edyn, UXCO Group, International Campus Group, Generator, Selenta and Experimental. 

Prior to joining Brookfield in 2012, Ms. Okada Young was an analyst in Bank of America Merrill Lynch’s real estate, gaming and lodging investment banking group, where she concentrated on M&A and corporate finance.

Ms. Okada Young holds a Bachelor of Arts degree from Colgate University.

people.name: Ryan Prince
people.title: Founder & CEO
people.bio:
After completing a post-graduate degree at the LSE, Ryan co-founded his first venture (aged 21) called iGabriel, a founders-only funded venture technology seed capital fund.

In 2002, he founded Realstar Capital LLP in 2002.  Since that time, Realstar has acquired or developed over £4B of real estate assets in the healthcare, hospitality and living sectors, including 13,000 hotel rooms under the Holiday Inn brand and 6,000 residential rental apartments under the UNCLE brand (which Ryan founded). In September 2025, the Realstar UK platform (including the UNCLE brand in the UK) was sold to QuadReal, the property arm of BCI.

Outside of work, Ryan is a member of the Leadership Council of Facing History & Ourselves and a member of the Board of Governors at the British Film Institute (BFI).

people.name: Jeff Tisdall
people.title: Chief Business Officer, Global Head of Mixed-Use
people.bio:
Jeff Tisdall is Chief Business Officer, Accor One Living and Global Head of Mixed-Use. Accor One Living is an industry first mixed-use platform, focused on the development and operation of branded residences. Leveraging Accor’s two decades of residential experience pioneered under iconic brands like Fairmont and Raffles, the Group is now developing trend setting residential solutions across luxury, lifestyle, premium and midscale segments. 

Prior to joining Accor in 2013 (via FRHI Hotels and Resorts), Tisdall was the Managing Director of Singapore-based LIFT, where he served as branded residential advisor to FRHI and the Jumeirah Group. Previously, Tisdall worked with Wyndham Worldwide in Dubai, as Managing Director with responsibility for the company’s RCI and Registry Collection brands in the Middle East and North Africa region. He was also Vice President of Real Estate at Kingdom Hotel Investments, where he managed the company’s residential and commercial real estate portfolio. Earlier in his career, Tisdall spent 13 years with Intrawest, leaving as a Senior Vice President at the company’s premium vacation ownership division. 

Tisdall holds a degree from McGill University in Canada and lives in Dubai with his family.
